tools.name: jobs_search
tools.description: Search 19.8M+ verified ATS & corporate career-site job postings across 434 sources (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, etc.) with structured USD compensation, canonical skills, remote flags, and direct ATS application URLs (1 Credit / job returned; 0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: jobs_detail
tools.description: Retrieve the complete 26-field job posting record by ID, including full HTML & plain-text job description, structured salary breakdown, extracted skills, and direct ATS application URL (1 Credit).

tools.name: jobs_count
tools.description: Count matching active job postings for hiring velocity tracking, GTM territory scoring, or pre-flight query sizing (1 Credit).

tools.name: jobs_feed_new
tools.description: Stream newly discovered job postings across 434 ATS & career portals since a relative window or ISO-8601 timestamp (1 Credit / event; 0 if empty).

tools.name: jobs_feed_updated
tools.description: Stream recently updated job postings (salary band revisions, location changes, or description edits) across 434 ATS sources.

tools.name: jobs_feed_closed
tools.description: Stream recently closed or filled job postings with closed_at timestamps so job boards and AI agents can immediately delist expired links.

tools.name: company_open_jobs
tools.description: List all active job postings for a specific company slug or domain, with optional live ETag refresh from Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby.

tools.name: detect_company_ats
tools.description: Detect which Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, etc.) a company domain uses and preview its open roles (0 Credits).
